name: 005-opportunity-discovery
title: Opportunity Discovery Radar (execution-agnostic)
description: Paper-only discovery track: inventory existing strategies and prospect new ones, measuring opportunity size/frequency/cadence with read-only evidence. No execution, no signing, no capital at risk. Output is a ranked, evidence-backed strategy backlog; winner(s) graduate to their own active track.
success_metrics: Every catalogued strategy has a 7-day paper log: candidate counts, sizes, cadence
Ranked strategy table with evidence (not opinion): frequency x median size x data confidence
At least one strategy graduates to an active-track proposal, or a written kill rationale per strategy
Zero signing, zero broadcasts, zero capital at risk for the entire track

venue.name: Read-only, multi-chain (same 14 Morpho API chains + DEX venues as available)

verified_baseline.source: defi-jev production logs 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-09 (483 cycles/12h): ~1,690 candidates/cycle pass $100 seize, 0 survive the pre-Jev exit-liquidity gate
verified_baseline.note: Baseline is discovery-only. The 12h evidence says Morpho-Blue liquidation racing on the current venue set yields zero realizable candidates; this track asks what else exists.

constraints: Paper only: no signing, no broadcasting, no position registry, no hold time
Discovery sources are on-chain reads or near-real-time oracles; off-chain APIs are pointers only and re-verified on-chain before G0
One strategy at a time: next starts only when the current one is decided (Graduate/Park/Kill)
Procedural gates G0-G3 (code, deterministic) evaluate every opportunity; gates judge data and economics only, never executability
Only gate survivors reach Jev, each under a per-strategy guideline block; Jev ranks/flags, never authorizes
Code never invents data: every logged opportunity cites its source (tx, pool state, API row)
Dashboard radar panel shows every strategy's live funnel in facts only: numbers with sources and timestamps, no adjectives
out_of_scope: database/persistence beyond flat JSONL paper logs
promoting a strategy to live trading (that is the graduating track's job)

adapt: paper-log schema from scan/status lines into a shared JSONL radar format
